seed_derivation: Two independent sha256-derived streams per scenario, each: sha256(seed_string) -> first 8 bytes (big-endian) -> non-negative int -> numpy.random.default_rng. No global RNG state, no wall-clock/date input. pattern_seed_string = f'{spec_version}|{scenario_id}|{regime}|pattern' (SEVERITY-INDEPENDENT -- one pattern per scenario per regime, shared across S1-S4; required for D-N1-10 per-pattern paired tests). placement_seed_string = f'{spec_version}|{scenario_id}|{severity}|{regime}' (severity-dependent; used only for duration sampling + block placement given the already-drawn pattern).
